verses.original: וַיִּתְפַּלֵּ֣ל יוֹנָ֔ה אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהָ֑יו מִמְּעֵ֖י הַדָּגָֽה׃
verses.literal: From inside the fish Jonah prayed to the LORD his God
verses.literalPt: E OROU Jonas ao SENHOR, seu Deus, das entranhas do peixe.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר קָ֠רָאתִי מִצָּ֥רָה לִ֛י אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה וַֽיַּעֲנֵ֑נִי מִבֶּ֧טֶן שְׁא֛וֹל שִׁוַּ֖עְתִּי שָׁמַ֥עְתָּ קוֹלִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer qā·rā·ṯî miṣ·ṣā·rāh lî ’el- Yah·weh way·ya·‘ă·nê·nî mib·be·ṭen šə·’ō·wl šiw·wa‘·tî šā·ma‘·tā qō·w·lî
verses.literal: saying In my distress I called to the LORD and He answered me From the belly of Sheol I called for help and You heard my voice
verses.literalPt: E disse: Na minha angústia clamei ao SENHOR, e ele me respondeu; do ventre do inferno gritei, e tu ouviste a minha voz.

verses.original: וַתַּשְׁלִיכֵ֤נִי מְצוּלָה֙ בִּלְבַ֣ב יַמִּ֔ים וְנָהָ֖ר יְסֹבְבֵ֑נִי כָּל־ מִשְׁבָּרֶ֥יךָ וְגַלֶּ֖יךָ עָלַ֥י עָבָֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·taš·lî·ḵê·nî mə·ṣū·lāh bil·ḇaḇ yam·mîm wə·nā·hār yə·sō·ḇə·ḇê·nî kāl- miš·bā·re·ḵā wə·ḡal·le·ḵā ‘ā·lay ‘ā·ḇā·rū
verses.literal: For You cast me into the deep into the heart of the seas and the current swirled about me all Your breakers and waves swept over me
verses.literalPt: Porque tu me lançaste no profundo, no coração dos mares, e a corrente das águas me cercou; todas as tuas ondas e as tuas vagas têm passado por cima de mim.

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֣י אָמַ֔רְתִּי נִגְרַ֖שְׁתִּי מִנֶּ֣גֶד עֵינֶ֑יךָ אַ֚ךְ אוֹסִ֣יף לְהַבִּ֔יט אֶל־ הֵיכַ֖ל קָדְשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî ’ā·mar·tî niḡ·raš·tî min·ne·ḡeḏ ‘ê·ne·ḵā ’aḵ ’ō·w·sîp̄ lə·hab·bîṭ ’el- hê·ḵal qāḏ·še·ḵā
verses.literal: At this, I said I have been banished from Your sight yet I will look once more toward Your holy temple
verses.literalPt: E eu disse: Lançado estou de diante dos teus olhos; todavia tornarei a ver o teu santo templo.

verses.original: אֲפָפ֤וּנִי מַ֙יִם֙ עַד־ נֶ֔פֶשׁ תְּה֖וֹם יְסֹבְבֵ֑נִי ס֖וּף חָב֥וּשׁ לְרֹאשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·p̄ā·p̄ū·nî ma·yim ‘aḏ- ne·p̄eš tə·hō·wm yə·sō·ḇə·ḇê·nî sūp̄ ḥā·ḇūš lə·rō·šî
verses.literal: The waters engulfed me to take my life the watery depths closed around me the seaweed wrapped around my head
verses.literalPt: As águas me cercaram até à alma, o abismo me rodeou, e as algas se enrolaram na minha cabeça.

verses.original: לְקִצְבֵ֤י הָרִים֙ יָרַ֔דְתִּי הָאָ֛רֶץ בְּרִחֶ֥יהָ בַעֲדִ֖י לְעוֹלָ֑ם וַתַּ֧עַל מִשַּׁ֛חַת חַיַּ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lə·qiṣ·ḇê hā·rîm yā·raḏ·tî hā·’ā·reṣ bə·ri·ḥe·hā ḇa·‘ă·ḏî lə·‘ō·w·lām wat·ta·‘al miš·ša·ḥaṯ ḥay·yay Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāy
verses.literal: To the roots of the mountains I descended the earth beneath me barred me in forever But You raised my life from the pit O LORD my God
verses.literalPt: Eu desci até aos fundamentos dos montes; a terra me encerrou para sempre com os seus ferrolhos; mas tu fizeste subir a minha vida da perdição, ó SENHOR meu Deus.

verses.original: בְּהִתְעַטֵּ֤ף עָלַי֙ נַפְשִׁ֔י אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה זָכָ֑רְתִּי וַתָּב֤וֹא אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ תְּפִלָּתִ֔י אֶל־ הֵיכַ֖ל קָדְשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·hiṯ·‘aṭ·ṭêp̄ ‘ā·lay nap̄·šî ’eṯ- Yah·weh zā·ḵā·rə·tî wat·tā·ḇō·w ’ê·le·ḵā tə·p̄il·lā·ṯî ’el- hê·ḵal qāḏ·še·ḵā
verses.literal: As my life was fading away . . . I remembered the LORD My prayer went up to You to Your holy temple
verses.literalPt: Quando desfalecia em mim a minha alma, lembrei-me do SENHOR; e entrou a ti a minha oração, no teu santo templo.

verses.literal: Those who cling to worthless idols forsake His loving devotion
verses.literalPt: Os que observam as falsas vaidades deixam a sua misericórdia.

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֗י בְּק֤וֹל תּוֹדָה֙ אֶזְבְּחָה־ לָּ֔ךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָדַ֖רְתִּי אֲשַׁלֵּ֑מָה יְשׁוּעָ֖תָה לַיהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî bə·qō·wl tō·w·ḏāh ’ez·bə·ḥāh- lāḵ ’ă·šer nā·ḏar·tî ’ă·šal·lê·māh yə·šū·‘ā·ṯāh Yah·weh
verses.literal: But I with the voice of thanksgiving will sacrifice to You I will fulfill what I have vowed Salvation is from the LORD
verses.literalPt: Mas eu te oferecerei sacrifício com a voz do agradecimento; o que votei pagarei. Do SENHOR vem a salvação.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה לַדָּ֑ג וַיָּקֵ֥א אֶת־ יוֹנָ֖ה אֶל־ הַיַּבָּשָֽׁה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh lad·dāḡ way·yā·qê ’eṯ- yō·w·nāh ’el- hay·yab·bā·šāh
verses.literal: And the LORD commanded the fish and it vomited Jonah onto dry land
verses.literalPt: Falou, pois, o SENHOR ao peixe, e este vomitou a Jonas na terra seca.
